first_closure.source: closed.bin: first frame with a closed road

peak_closed_time.source: closed.bin: first frame at the peak

max_vehicles.source: manifest traffic.max_vehicles, largest of the five strategies, rounded up

gauge_time.source: sp3_runs/baselines/gauge_choices.json:folds/Radardata/budgets/0.5/plan/rise_m, rebuilt as a schedule; its T3 equals test/cases (shift 0) in the same record

folds_variant.text: a version of the learned policy trained from random starting points rather than the one shown above
folds_variant.value: a version of the learned policy trained from random starting points rather than the one shown above
folds_variant.source: docs/reports/sp3_results.md section 5: Radardata across folds, seeds 0 and 1, no grid start (sp3_results.json across_folds records seeds but not the start type)

caveat.text: These are first-round results; an updated analysis is under way.
caveat.value: These are first-round results; an updated analysis is under way.

library_floods.source: docs/reports/sp3_results.json:across_folds/folds, one fold per flood of the library (the gauge table holds the same number of floods)

flood_watch_time.source: T1 of the schedules (runs.order_times t1, shared by all five strategies), shown as clock time by the export's cdt()

flood_watch_day.source: T1 of the schedules (same as flood_watch_time), its date

gauge_rules_n.source: floodevac.opt.baselines.gauge_plans() (equals the gauge rules in sp3_runs/baselines/gauge_table.npz)

gauge_all_worse.text: on the training floods, every one of them did worse than no warning
gauge_all_worse.value: on the training floods, every one of them did worse than no warning
gauge_all_worse.source: sp3_runs/baselines/gauge_table.npz: mean expected life loss on the 161 training cases (every flood but Radardata) of each of the 16 gauge rules above no_warning's 62.0020 (least: 63.5525); asserted by the export

policy_no_order_people.source: policy schedule (runs.order_times t3 not issued) x homes.json rows: people in rows whose area gets no T3 order

policy_no_order_homes.source: policy schedule x homes.json: drawn buildings (distinct pt) none of whose rows' areas gets a T3 order

forced_peak.source: manifest checks.forced10.peak_vs_ctm_report.export (equals the CTM report's docs/reports/ctm_verification.json runs.x10_wet.peak.vehicles_on_network within 1e-6)

note: Each number's text is what the story shows; value is the raw value; source names the file and key it was read from. Expected life loss values are SP3's (GPU); the dashboard's CPU re-runs match them within 0.02 (manifest checks).
